tips.title: Tips & tricks
tips.treeText: Add parent-child connections via relations. The family tree then arranges your family members hierarchically.
tips.searchText: Filter persons by first or last name using the search field in the top bar.
tips.datesText: Enter historical dates as you know them – e.g. "1880", "05.1880", "about 1880" or "1880-1885". The precision is detected automatically.
